name: Fireworks Stars
overview: Rebellious heir Li Shang and hometown café owner Li Zi reunite years after their first love faded. As Li Shang struggles to save his family’s fireworks factory and Li Zi builds her live-streaming business, they join forces to preserve the fading art of traditional fireworks. Through setbacks, ambition, and rekindled affection, their shared passion ignites both a cultural revival and a radiant new chapter in their love story.
